This reinforced my initial ranking, as it highlighted the trade-offs between pure equality (floor) and efficiency (average), with constraints adding nuance. 4. **Maximizing Average with Range Constraint**: Prioritizes maximizing average income while limiting the income difference between the richest and poorest (the range) to a specified amount. This prevents excessive disparities, requiring specification of the dollar difference.
